subject.title: ci: scope PR Node tests to changed targets

question: Should canonical pull requests replace the fourteen-job compact Node suite with one inferred changed-target job whenever the planner reports a precise bounded result?
rationale: Automated tests can validate the planner's modeled cases, but only maintainers can accept the operational tradeoff between runner-capacity relief and the residual risk that repository-wide or package-specifier dependencies are not modeled.

options.title: Pilot, prove, then merge
options.body: Remove the unrelated UI delta and require hosted canary runs for both targeted and full-fallback routing before adopting the policy.

options.title: Merge after current checks
options.body: Accept the modeled fail-safe coverage and land once the exact head is green, without an additional hosted targeted canary.

options.title: Retain the full matrix
options.body: Close or redesign the proposal if maintainers prefer complete compact-suite coverage on every Node-relevant pull request.

recommendation.title: Pilot, prove, then merge
recommendation.body: Remove the unrelated UI delta and require hosted canary runs for both targeted and full-fallback routing before adopting the policy.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal is repeated ownership of Node sharding, changed-scope routing, CI critical-path, and runner-capacity work.
